ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure separately shows the three layers of a 3-pyramid: the left layer is a triangular ball array with side length 3, with 3, 2, 1 rows in total; the middle layer is a triangular ball array with side length 2; the right layer is a single ball with side length 1. The problem says the outside balls are all black, and the bottom layer is also all black, so the bottom layer with side length 8 contributes no white balls. For each triangular layer above the bottom layer, the balls on the three sides are all on the outside slanted faces and are black; only the internal balls after removing the three sides are white. After a triangular layer with side length m has its three sides removed, the inside forms a triangular layer with side length m-3. Therefore among the upper layers 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, only 7, 6, 5, 4 will leave positive internal layers, respectively white layer side lengths 4, 3, 2, 1. So the white balls form a 4-layer pyramid.

raw_record.question_text:
An $n$-pyramid is defined to be a stack of $n$ layers of balls, with each layer forming a triangular array. The layers of a 3-pyramid are shown in the diagram.
An 8-pyramid is now formed where all the balls on the outside of the 8-pyramid are black (including the base layer) and the balls on the inside are all white. How many layers are there in the white pyramid?

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: the 3-pyramid is shown as three separated triangular layers, with side lengths 3, 2, and 1 balls, so an 8-pyramid has horizontal triangular layers of side lengths 8, 7, 6, ..., 1. From the text, all balls on the outside, including the base layer, are black; only fully interior balls are white. For each horizontal layer above the base, remove the three edge rows of that triangular array because those balls lie on the three sloping outside faces. A triangular layer of side length m then has an interior triangular layer of side length m-3. After discarding the base layer of side length 8, the remaining layer sizes are 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1; only 7, 6, 5, and 4 leave positive interiors, giving white layer sizes 4, 3, 2, and 1. Therefore the white balls form a 4-layer pyramid.

图像描述：图中把一个 3-pyramid 的三层分开画出：左边一层是边长为 3 的三角形球阵，共 3、2、1 排；中间一层是边长为 2 的三角形球阵；右边一层是边长为 1 的单个球。由此可见，n-pyramid 的水平层边长依次为 n, n-1, ..., 1。

推理：8-pyramid 的各层边长为 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1。题目说外面的球都是黑色，并且底层也全是黑色，所以边长 8 的底层不贡献白球。对底层上方的每个三角形层，三条边上的球都在外侧斜面上，是黑色；只有去掉三条边后的内部球是白色。边长为 m 的三角形层去掉三边后，内部形成边长 m-3 的三角形层。因此上方各层 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 中，只有 7, 6, 5, 4 会留下正的内部层，分别为白色层边长 4, 3, 2, 1。所以白球组成一个 4 层的金字塔。
